stamp: {"keys":[{"id":"k","problem":"The current-account guide carries template sections that do not fit it (who offers it, money in and out, tax and the like), padding the page.","where":"the sections 'who', 'in and out', 'tax' of the guide","kind":"general"}],"liked":[]}

raised: The page gives no figures (returns, fees, risk), so the promised comparison isn't possible and deciding is hard
Nothing tells a 61-year-old what to do with pension money; nothing is aimed at someone near retirement
The 'כסף שוטף וקצר' cards are cut off and can't be read properly
The retirement section is the hardest to understand
The 'לילדים' section isn't relevant to the reader
'לבחירה עצמית' seems to be for experts only
The nine index ('מדד') cards all sound alike
Footer says 'data correct as of' but no numbers are visible
The 'יומית' and 'מתחדשת' buttons under קרן כספית are unexplained
Abbreviations (מק"מ, אג"ח) in the top block are not explained
'Exposure to the dollar or neutralised' is unclear: more risk or less?
'תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים' is a mouthful, and the difference between קרן מקיפה and כללית at 61 is unclear
'At the discretion of the investment committee' leaves unclear who decides and what they charge
MSCI AC World vs MSCI World difference is unclear
No information on what changes at 60/67: withdrawals and tax at that age
No mention of management fees anywhere
Risk of each product (can it lose money, how much) is missing
No rough returns given
Lock-up period for קרן השתלמות ('period set by law') not stated
No information on deposit guarantee if the bank or fund fails
Would drop most index cards, the children section, and the self-directed section

problems.why: None of the reader's problems says the current-account guide is padded with template sections that don't fit it ('who', 'in and out', 'tax'). The reader only saw the guide-list page and its cut-off cards, and never commented on the sections inside a product guide.

The short-term money cards are cut off in the screenshots and can't be read properly
The retirement section is the hardest to understand: jargon like 'תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים', and the difference between קרן מקיפה and כללית is unclear
Nine 'מדד' (index) cards all sound alike; the reader would cut them down to one
Footer says 'data correct as of' a date, but no data or numbers are visible
The 'יומית' / 'מתחדשת' buttons under קרן כספית are unexplained
Abbreviations מק"מ and אג"ח appear unexplained in the top block
Unclear what 'exposure to the dollar or neutralised from it' means for risk
'At the discretion of the investment committee': who they are and what they charge is unclear
Can't tell MSCI AC World from MSCI World without reading both cards twice
No fees (דמי ניהול) mentioned anywhere
Risk isn't stated for most products (which can lose money and how much)
No indication of typical returns
Lock-up period for קרן השתלמות ('period set by law') not stated
No information on whether there is a deposit guarantee
The 'לילדים' section isn't relevant; the reader would drop it
The 'לבחירה עצמית' section seems for experts; the reader would drop it
